subject: Preserve terminal ownership across multi-drafter telemetry failures
origin: Original MLX2 integration repair; no external source copied.
modifications: Contain drafter receipt observation exceptions at the serving terminal seam so malformed telemetry cannot fail the worker or prevent request cleanup and terminal delivery.
Preserve incoming drafter_metric_failures accounting through HostCounters/count_add, receipt-log locking, and observations outside the lifecycle lock.
Retain incoming tenant_metrics_scoped behavior: verified scoped operation passes each job's tenant; unscoped operation aggregates under default.

After incoming conversion hardening made malformed counters nonthrowing, inject a failure of the observer itself through a tiny CPU ServingEngine. Verify both scoped and default aggregation paths preserve completion, owner cleanup, a second request, and exactly one diagnostic failure.
Independently verify malformed counters and depth maps are accepted by the actual hardened aggregator while valid fields reach both tenant and operator snapshots.

validation.regression_before_fix: On the original portfolio integration, the injected conversion error escaped the worker and emitted a 503. Subsequent upstream conversion hardening removes that trigger; the terminal regression now injects an independent observer failure.

limits: A failed observation can leave partial telemetry aggregates; it is counted and logged, without retry or duplicate completion.
